description: Generate strong, random passwords with full control over length and character sets. Passwords are created locally in your browser — nothing is ever sent anywhere.
howto: Drag the length slider to choose 8 to 64 characters.
Tick the character sets you want to include.
Click Generate Password to create one.
Use the strength meter as a guide and copy your password.
title: Password Generator

faqs.a: With all character sets enabled it has roughly 105 bits of entropy, which is effectively unbreakable by brute force. The strength meter shows the estimate for your exact settings.

faqs.q: Are my passwords sent to a server?
faqs.a: No. Generation uses your browser’s built-in cryptographic random number generator (Web Crypto API) and nothing ever leaves your device.
Symbols increase the character pool and therefore strength. Some older sites reject them, so you can turn them off if needed.
